meta.name: glycoengineering
meta.description: Analyze and engineer protein glycosylation. Scan sequences for N-glycosylation sequons (N-X-S/T), predict O-glycosylation hotspots, and access curated glycoengineering tools (NetOGlyc, GlycoShield, GlycoWorkbench). For glycoprotein engineering, therapeutic antibody optimization, and vaccine design.

copy.tagline: 分析蛋白质糖基化位点并设计工程方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果从事治疗性抗体或疫苗的糖基化设计与优化。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze protein glycosylation sites and engineer glycoproteins
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work on glycosylation design for therapeutic antibodies or vaccines.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能分析蛋白质序列中的糖基化位点，预测 N-糖基化和 O-糖基化热点，并提供外部工具（如 NetOGlyc、GlycoShield、GlycoWorkbench）的使用指引。
howto.when: 当你提供蛋白质序列，并询问糖基化分析、抗体工程、疫苗设计或治疗性蛋白优化时触发。

say.text: 分析这段 IgG1 Fc 序列的 N-糖基化位点。
帮我预测这段序列的 O-糖基化热点。
say.note: Claude 会基于 S/T 密度给出候选位点。

say.text: 如何去除 Fc 区域的糖基化位点？
say.note: Claude 会建议 N297A/Q 等突变策略。

howto.what_en: Analyze protein sequences for N- and O-glycosylation sites, predict hotspots, and provide guidance on using external glycoengineering tools like NetOGlyc, GlycoShield, and GlycoWorkbench.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a protein sequence and ask about glycosylation analysis, antibody engineering, vaccine design, or therapeutic protein optimization.

say_en.text: Analyze N-glycosylation sites in this IgG1 Fc sequence.
say_en.note: Claude will scan and list all N-X-S/T sequons.

say_en.text: Predict O-glycosylation hotspots for this sequence.
say_en.note: Claude will output candidate sites based on S/T density.

say_en.text: How to remove glycosylation sites in Fc region?
say_en.note: Claude will suggest mutations like N297A/Q.
